brief:
Children with diabetes across Gaza face a critical shortage of insulin and blood glucose testing supplies, Al Jazeera English reported. The medical crisis stems from ongoing conflict that has disrupted supply chains and healthcare infrastructure throughout the territory, leaving families unable to obtain life-saving medication.

The scarcity has forced some families to ration insulin or seek alternative treatments, putting young patients at serious health risk. Healthcare workers warn that without consistent access to insulin, diabetic children face complications ranging from immediate metabolic emergencies to long-term organ damage.
dek: Insulin and blood glucose testing supplies become increasingly difficult to obtain in war-torn Gaza.
title: Insulin shortage threatens diabetic children in Gaza
